policy.binding: Public factory/plugin names and prefix option/limit are pending; root supplies mechanical adapter only after candidate finished. No proposed names imported here.
policy.reporting: Each case has semantic/safety and native-exact lanes. Unsupported, profile-conflict, backend-limitation, harness-defect and oracle-unavailable are NOT passes. Report 40 denominator and 80 content-view denominator separately; native probes are reference observations, never candidate passes.
policy.assertions: Semantic MIME alias sets are frozen before candidate inspection; native exact MIME/encoding is captured independently and never rewritten to match a candidate. Human labels use semantic regex only. Error stderr need not contain errno literals.
policy.limits: Classifier, not full file validator. No decompression; no full libmagic parity or unsupported-option matrix. Native bounded -P bytes=65536 fixtures only. Exact file-vs-stdin and prefix-vs-full-source differences stay visible.
policy.sourceAuditLater: After candidate freeze, review owned author sources for runtime deps/subprocesses/host fs/libmagic/decompression. No behavioral holdout can universally prove absence of host access; the dedicated canary only covers its exercised route.
